cases.input:
run create_command for sqlmap against the login form at https://portal.example.com/login?returnUrl=1, the returnUrl parameter is the one I'm testing, use a random user agent and batch mode so it doesn't prompt me

sqlmap -h
Usage: python sqlmap [options]

Options:
  -u URL, --url=URL   Target URL
  -p TESTPARAMETER    Testable parameter(s)
  --random-agent      Use randomly selected HTTP User-Agent header
  --batch             Never ask for user input, use the default behavior
  --level=LEVEL       Level of tests to perform (1-5, default 1)
  --risk=RISK         Risk of tests to perform (1-3, default 1)
  --forms             Parse and test forms on target URL
  --cookie=COOKIE     HTTP Cookie header value
  -v VERBOSE          Verbosity level (0-6, default 1)
cases.expects: One bash command for sqlmap that uses -u, -p, --random-agent and --batch exactly as documented, pulling in --forms or --level/--risk only if the request actually implies them, never switches absent from the pasted help. Output is the command alone, nothing else.

cases.input:
need a hydra command to brute-force SSH on 203.0.113.9, user is 'backup-svc', wordlist is /tmp/rockyou-small.txt, go fast with like 32 threads and don't lock the account out after a few tries

Hydra v9.4 (c) 2023 by van Hauser/THC
Syntax: hydra [[[-l LOGIN|-L FILE] [-p PASS|-P FILE]] | [-C FILE]] [-e nsr] [-o FILE] [-t TASKS] [-M FILE [-T TASKS]] [-w TIME] [-W TIME] [-f] [-s PORT] [-S] [-v/-V] server service [OPT]

Options:
  -l LOGIN   login with LOGIN name
  -L FILE    login names from FILE
  -p PASS    try password PASS
  -P FILE    try passwords from FILE
  -t TASKS   run TASKS number of connects in parallel (default 16)
  -f         exit after first found login/password pair
  -s PORT    use PORT instead of default protocol port
  -V/-v      verbose mode
cases.expects: A hydra command using -l, -P, -t 32, server and service only from the documented syntax, with no lockout-avoidance switch invented since the help text has none for it; the account-lockout request is simply not represented rather than papered over with a fake flag. Output is the bare command, exact and literal to the switches shown, nothing added that the principal didn't ask for or that help doesn't support.
